import requests

for iso_id in ['Q96LJ8-1', 'Q96LJ8-2', 'P07355-1', 'P07355-2', 'P07355-3']:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso_id}.fasta")
    lines = r.text.splitlines()
    seq = "".join([l for l in lines if not l.startswith(">")])
    # calculate molecular weight using Bio.SeqUtils
    from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
    X = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
    print(iso_id, len(seq), f"{X.molecular_weight():.1f} Da", f"{X.molecular_weight()/1000:.2f} kDa")
